# Configuration

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_configuration_docs.py.
     Do not edit by hand: change backend/app/core/config.py or
     .env.example and rerun the script; a test fails when this file
     drifts from those sources. -->

Aegis Vuldris is configured entirely through environment variables. A `.env`
file in the working directory is read when present, but the environment
takes priority; deployed systems should inject variables from a secrets
manager and never ship a `.env`. See
[secrets-management.md](secrets-management.md) for handling rules and
[deployment.md](deployment.md) for production values.

Regenerate this reference with:

```bash
python scripts/generate_configuration_docs.py
```

## Variables

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `APP_NAME` | `str` | `Aegis Vuldris` | Reported as the service name by the health and readiness endpoints. |
| `APP_ENV` | one of `development`, `testing`, `staging`, `production` | `development` | development \| testing \| staging \| production staging and production require a non-empty SECRET_KEY or the app refuses to start. |
| `DATABASE_URL` | `str` | (empty) | Required. PostgreSQL is required (the models use JSONB and native enums). The database must use the UTF8 encoding: JSONB payloads can contain any Unicode, and a non-UTF8 cluster corrupts non-ASCII payloads on write. See docs/troubleshooting.md#database-encoding. |
| `SECRET_KEY` | `str` | (empty) | Required for staging and production. Generate with: python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(32))" This value derives the Fernet key protecting stored target credentials and signs JWTs. Losing it makes stored credentials permanently undecryptable. Rotating it invalidates every stored credential and logs all users out. Never commit a real value. See docs/secrets-management.md. |
| `JWT_ALGORITHM` | `str` | `HS256` | JWT signing algorithm and access-token lifetime, in minutes. |
| `ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES` | `int` | `30` | How long a newly issued access token stays valid, in minutes. |
| `RUNNER_SERVICE_TOKEN` | `str` | (empty) | Shared secret the runner presents on the internal claim and report endpoints. Empty disables those endpoints entirely. Generate with the same command as SECRET_KEY and never commit a real value. |
| `RUNNER_CLAIM_LEASE_SECONDS` | `int` | `3600` | How long a runner's claim over a queued scan stays valid, in seconds. An older claim is treated as abandoned and the scan can be claimed again. |
| `EXTERNAL_SCAN_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES` | `int` | `240` | How long the per-scan bearer token handed to a runner stays valid, in minutes. |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | one of `DEBUG`, `INFO`, `WARNING`, `ERROR`, `CRITICAL` | `INFO` | Minimum severity for log output; one of DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL. |
| `ALLOW_LOCAL_TARGETS` | `bool` | `false` | Permits target endpoints on loopback or private addresses. Leave this false in any deployed environment: it is the setting that stops Aegis Vuldris from being pointed at internal infrastructure. Set ALLOW_LOCAL_TARGETS=true only to test a model bound to the same machine. |
| `ALLOW_THIRD_PARTY_PLUGINS` | `bool` | `true` | Permits loading third-party plugins (adapters, graders, attack case directories, report exporters) discovered through Python entry points. Community default: allowed, a self-hosted responsibility. A hosted pilot sets ALLOW_THIRD_PARTY_PLUGINS=false so only first-party code runs. |
| `AEGIS_REPORT_DIR` | (read directly) | `/tmp/aegis/reports` | Where generated report artifacts are written. Mount this on a persistent volume in production or reports are lost when the container is replaced. |

## Example `.env`

The annotated template. Copy it and fill in the required values; the
template itself is safe to commit, a real `.env` never is.

```dotenv
# Application
#
# Reported as the service name by the health and readiness endpoints.
APP_NAME=Aegis Vuldris

# development | testing | staging | production
# staging and production require a non-empty SECRET_KEY or the app refuses to start.
APP_ENV=development

# Database
#
# Required. PostgreSQL is required (the models use JSONB and native enums).
# The database must use the UTF8 encoding: JSONB payloads can contain any
# Unicode, and a non-UTF8 cluster corrupts non-ASCII payloads on write. See
# docs/troubleshooting.md#database-encoding.
DATABASE_URL=

# Security
#
# Required for staging and production. Generate with:
#   python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(32))"
# This value derives the Fernet key protecting stored target credentials and
# signs JWTs. Losing it makes stored credentials permanently undecryptable.
# Rotating it invalidates every stored credential and logs all users out.
# Never commit a real value. See docs/secrets-management.md.
SECRET_KEY=

# JWT signing algorithm and access-token lifetime, in minutes.
JWT_ALGORITHM=HS256
# How long a newly issued access token stays valid, in minutes.
ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES=30

# External scan runner
#
# Shared secret the runner presents on the internal claim and report endpoints.
# Empty disables those endpoints entirely. Generate with the same command as
# SECRET_KEY and never commit a real value.
RUNNER_SERVICE_TOKEN=
# How long a runner's claim over a queued scan stays valid, in seconds. An
# older claim is treated as abandoned and the scan can be claimed again.
RUNNER_CLAIM_LEASE_SECONDS=3600
# How long the per-scan bearer token handed to a runner stays valid, in minutes.
EXTERNAL_SCAN_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES=240

# Logging
#
# Minimum severity for log output; one of DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL.
LOG_LEVEL=INFO

# Network policy
#
# Permits target endpoints on loopback or private addresses. Leave this false
# in any deployed environment: it is the setting that stops Aegis Vuldris from being
# pointed at internal infrastructure. Set ALLOW_LOCAL_TARGETS=true only to
# test a model bound to the same machine.
ALLOW_LOCAL_TARGETS=false

# Extension policy
#
# Permits loading third-party plugins (adapters, graders, attack case
# directories, report exporters) discovered through Python entry points.
# Community default: allowed, a self-hosted responsibility. A hosted pilot
# sets ALLOW_THIRD_PARTY_PLUGINS=false so only first-party code runs.
ALLOW_THIRD_PARTY_PLUGINS=true

# Reports
#
# Where generated report artifacts are written. Mount this on a persistent
# volume in production or reports are lost when the container is replaced.
AEGIS_REPORT_DIR=/var/lib/aegis/reports
```
